phrase.zh: 一份身份证明，为前行多一份可能。
phrase.en: Proof of identity can open a way forward.

visual.zh: 低视角下，两扇铁门向外打开；一册摊开的薄证件册横跨前景石台之间的暗色间隙，远处地面从门间延伸。
visual.en: Two open iron gates frame a low viewpoint. An open thin booklet spans the dark gap between the foreground stone ledges, with the ground beyond extending through the gateway.

background.zh:
南森国际难民事务处获得1938年诺贝尔和平奖。诺贝尔奖官方资料介绍了该机构对难民的援助，以及南森护照作为身份证明的作用。画面让一册薄证件跨过石台间隙，远处两扇铁门打开，以此表达身份证明与通行机会的联系。这是原创寓意，不是真实护照样本，也不表示任何证件能够保证入境或获得安置；获奖者是机构，并非个人。短句为原创。
1938年和平奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：延续弗里乔夫·南森的工作，为欧洲难民提供援助
background.en:
The Nansen International Office for Refugees received the 1938 Nobel Peace Prize. Official Nobel sources describe its refugee assistance and the role of Nansen passports as identity documents. A thin booklet bridges a gap between stone ledges beneath open gates, an original metaphor for identity and opportunities to move forward. It is not a real passport design or a guarantee of entry or resettlement. The laureate is an organization, not an individual. The phrase is original.
1938 — The Nobel Peace Prize. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for having carried on the work of Fridtjof Nansen to the benefit of refugees across Europe
